CBS_service_curve_explanation.worst_case: Occurs when frame arrives with maximum negative credit, requiring time to accumulate sufficient credits before transmission

WCD_equation_general.delay_bound: d = sup{tau >= 0: alpha(tau) > beta(t + tau - tau)}, simplified for CBS
WCD_equation_general.total_WCD: WCD = sum(d_hop for each switch) + N_hops * (prop + switch + sync) + L_final/R_link
